info.description: Household spending, balance observations and investment gains
info.title: VibeLedger API

get.description: Lists accounts belonging to the authenticated household.

schema.title: Response List Accounts Api V1 Accounts Get

post.description:
Creates a new account in the authenticated household as a short durable command.
Spending and balance observations are independent; does not create transactions or snapshots.

get.description: Retrieves detail of an account in the authenticated household.

schema.title: Response Get Account Api V1 Accounts  Account Id  Get

patch.description: Updates mutable metadata on an account using row_version optimistic concurrency control as a short durable command.

schema.title: Response List Account Aliases Api V1 Accounts  Account Id  Aliases Get

post.description: Creates a new alias for an account as a short durable command.

patch.description: Updates an existing account alias as a short durable command.

post.description: Cancels an unused account with no financial references as a short durable command.
Closes an active account as a short durable command. Requires expected_version, closing_snapshot_id (explicit zero balance), and closed_on.
Reopens a closed account as a short durable command, clearing closed_on.

get.description: Lists active and/or inactive categories belonging to the authenticated household.

schema.title: Response List Categories Api V1 Categories Get

post.description: Creates a new category under the authenticated household as a short durable command.

schema.title: Response Get Category Api V1 Categories  Category Id  Get

patch.description: Updates an existing category within the authenticated household as a short durable command.

get.description:
Lists registered devices for the authenticated caller.
Credentials (token hashes) are strictly redacted.

schema.title: Response List Devices Api V1 Devices Get

post.description: Provisions a new device and returns the high-entropy raw Bearer token ONCE.

schema.title: Response Create Device Api V1 Devices Post

post.description:
Atomically revokes an active device as a durable command.
The device token will immediately fail subsequent authentication.

get.description:
Retrieves append-only change history for a specific entity within the authenticated household.
If the entity exists in another household or is unauthorized, returns 404.

parameters.description: Target entity type, e.g. account, category, transaction
parameters.name: entity_type
